name: RF & Microwave Engineering
summary: Designing circuits above ~100 MHz: microwave network analysis, matching, couplers, filters, amplifiers, mixers, oscillators and RF system budgets.

topics.name: Microwave network analysis: Z, Y, S and ABCD matrices, signal-flow graphs
Microwave filter design (insertion-loss method, Richards and Kuroda)
Noise figure, non-linearity, IP3 and dynamic range
Microwave amplifier design: stability, gain circles, LNAs and PAs
RF receiver and transmitter architectures, cascade budgets
Vector network analyzer measurements and calibration
Millimetre-wave design and RF PCB practice
